reviewer: Agent-assisted source and reuse desk review; not legal, taxonomic, or field certification
purpose: Record a bounded Central Luzon discovery screen and its unresolved reuse terms without copying occurrence-level data into the public research repository or app.

source.provider: California Academy of Sciences via GBIF
source.citation: Fong J (2026). CAS Ichthyology (ICH). California Academy of Sciences. Occurrence dataset. https://doi.org/10.15468/efh2ib accessed via GBIF on 2026-11-26.
source.reviewScope: Dataset metadata, the bounded aggregate occurrence search, five exact waterBody-field follow-up query counts, and the provider terms page. No occurrence-level content is copied into this review.

discoveryScreen.taxonomicInterpretation: The checklist key pins the search to the GBIF Catalogue of Life eXtended Release taxonomy; the supplied taxon key selects Actinopterygii in that checklist. This is a discovery screen, not a verified fish inventory.
discoveryScreen.followUpScope: Five separately run exact waterBody-field searches among the Zambales screen. The field labels and row-level results are deliberately omitted here while source reuse terms remain unresolved.
discoveryScreen.interpretation: These are GBIF search results from a preserved-specimen collection and are not evidence of current presence, fishability, catchability, water quality, or an exhaustive list. Administrative matching and a populated waterBody field do not by themselves verify a field station or exact waterbody identity.

gbifMetadata.statement: The dataset page identifies the publisher as the California Academy of Sciences and displays a CC0 1.0 dataset licence.

providerTerms.source: California Academy of Sciences Terms of Use
providerTerms.relevantClauses: The terms describe Academy Content as owned by the Academy and/or licensors, restrict unauthorized distribution, copying, publication and other uses, state personal/non-commercial use limits, and prohibit automated access to Academy services without express written permission.
providerTerms.scopeNote: The page's application to records republished by GBIF under the dataset-level CC0 declaration has not been clarified for this batch. No legal conclusion is made.

reuseReview.decision: Do not redistribute occurrence-level names, identifiers, locality strings, coordinates, images, or derived row tables from this batch in Bangwit or the public source repository while the provider-terms versus GBIF-licence scope remains unresolved. Do not scrape the Academy collection website. A future rights clarification must be item- or dataset-specific and documented before projection.

limits: The 548-row screen is a bounded query result, not a provincial fish roster or evidence of occurrence absence outside the search.
The 19 follow-up result rows are an aggregate result count only; no row-level result was copied into this repository.
The difference between the GBIF CC0 dataset metadata and the Academy terms page requires source-specific clarification; this review does not resolve it.
No field survey, voucher examination, taxonomic re-identification, waterbody crosswalk, coordinate validation, or legal review was performed.
